# application of the Contrast workflow | file under example/ that its SBoB replaces
# a CNCF project has one folder, example/<project>/, for all of its applications
# an application that is not listed goes to example/contrast/cp-<application>.yaml
argo-workflows|example/argo/cp-argo-workflows.yaml
cert-manager|example/cert-manager/cp-cert-manager.yaml
cnpg|example/cloudnative-pg/cp-cnpg.yaml
registry|example/distribution/cp-registry.yaml

envoy-gateway|example/envoy/cp-envoy-gateway.yaml
falco-new|example/falco/cp-falco-new.yaml
falco-old|example/falco/cp-falco-old.yaml
